product_name: Bajaj Life Accidental Permanent Total/Partial Disability Benefit Rider II
regulatory_descriptor: A Non-Linked, Non-Participating Individual Accidental Permanent Total/Partial Disability Benefit Rider
key_benefits: Accidental Permanent Partial Disability: 50% of Rider Sum Assured payable (one-time; no further partial-disability benefit thereafter; rider continues to cover total disability)
Accidental Permanent Total Disability (no prior partial benefit): higher of Rider Sum Assured or Guaranteed Benefit; rider terminates thereafter
Accidental Permanent Total Disability after a partial-disability benefit (within 1 year): 50% of Rider Sum Assured; rider terminates
Accidental Permanent Total Disability after a partial-disability benefit (at least 1 year later): higher of Rider Sum Assured or Guaranteed Benefit; rider terminates
Disability must arise within 180 days from the date of the accident
Optional Health Management Services (medical second opinion, case management, consultation) at no additional cost
Rider can be surrendered at any time; Rider Termination Value (if any) paid on surrender

eligibility.policy_term: Rider term and premium-payment term align with the remaining term of the base policy, subject to the Board Approved Underwriting Policy
eligibility.premium_payment_term: Rider premium collected over and above the base policy premium; based on Rider Sum Assured, rider term and rider premium-payment term
eligibility.note: This is a rider attachable to allowed base products; standalone numeric eligibility (entry/maturity ages, sum assured) not present in this parse and is governed by the base policy / underwriting.

key_terms.free_look_note: 30 days from the date of receipt of the rider policy document.
key_terms.suicide_clause: Not separately applicable — this is an accident-only disability rider with no death benefit; benefits are triggered only by accidental permanent disability arising within 180 days of the accident.
key_terms.maturity_benefit_condition: There is NO death benefit and NO maturity benefit under this rider.
key_terms.guaranteed_benefit_note: On Accidental Permanent Total Disability (in eligible scenarios), the higher of Rider Sum Assured or the Guaranteed Benefit is payable; partial-disability payout is fixed at 50% of Rider Sum Assured (one-time).
key_terms.disability_window_note: The disability must occur within 180 days from the date of the accident, solely and directly resulting from it, to be payable.
key_terms.tax_note: GST applicable as per prevailing Tax Laws, subject to amendment.

mandatory_disclosures_present: 'This brochure should be read in conjunction with the Benefit Illustration and Policy Exclusions' statement

claims_marketing_must_support: This is a RIDER attachable to a base policy — it cannot be marketed as a standalone plan or as life cover.
Benefit triggers ONLY on Accidental Permanent Total/Partial Disability arising within 180 days of the accident — any claim must reflect the accident-only, 180-day condition.
Partial Disability pays a fixed 50% of Rider Sum Assured and is one-time only; subsequent partial-disability events are not paid again.
On Total Disability the rider terminates; the exact payout depends on whether a prior partial-disability benefit was paid and the time elapsed.
Health Management Services are optional, third-party provided, and may be discontinued/changed by the Company — not a guaranteed contractual benefit.
claims_marketing_must_avoid: Do NOT position this rider as an investment, savings, maturity, money-back or life-cover product — there is no death benefit and no maturity benefit.
Do NOT use 'guaranteed returns' / 'bonus' language — it is a non-linked, non-participating pure-protection rider.
Do NOT imply cover for disability due to illness — only ACCIDENTAL permanent disability (within 180 days of the accident) is covered.
Do NOT imply the full Sum Assured is paid for partial disability — partial disability pays 50% only.
Do NOT market it independently of a base policy.
must_state: That this is an Accidental Permanent Total/Partial Disability Benefit Rider II attached to a base policy (not a standalone plan)
The accident-only / 180-day disability trigger condition and the 50% partial-disability payout
Standard disclaimer to read the policy document / benefit illustration for full terms and exclusions
